title: The king's seal (found via an easily-missed optional side room, the King's Strongroom) turns out to be reusable much later at Highward ('You already carry my seal') and at the very end (reading a note off it grants a level-up) -- a nice callback, but nothing on the item description itself hints that it has more than one use, so its full value is easy to undersell.
